name: Learning from human guidance and feedback
gist: Teaching agents by showing them examples of good behavior or asking them to prefer one action over another, without needing to specify rewards.
explain: Sometimes you don't have a clear reward signal. How much should a robot value a gentle grip versus a secure grip? There is no number for 'good behavior.' But humans can show it. Watch a human pick something fragile, and a robot can learn the pattern: 'this is the gentle motion I should copy, because humans use it for delicate objects.' Or ask a human to pick between two proposed actions — 'I prefer this one' — and the robot learns: 'that action is better than that one, so I should do more of it.' This is learning from human guidance, and it sidesteps the problem of having to define a reward function by getting the reward signal from human choices instead.

The challenge is that humans give noisy feedback. People make mistakes, get tired, and explain things differently. A robot watching a human might learn the wrong thing if the human was having a bad day. And if the human is being asked to choose between hundreds of options, they won't have time. Papers in this area use techniques like inverse reinforcement learning — figuring out what reward function the human must be optimizing for by watching their choices — or preference learning, where humans rank a small number of options and the system infers a reward model from those rankings.

This approach is important because it lets humans shape behavior without having to write a formula. A company can refine an AI system's decisions by saying 'I like this approach better' without explaining why. A robot learns collaborative tasks by watching and learning what partners prefer.

papers.title: EXPO: Stable Reinforcement Learning with Expressive Policies
papers.contribution: EXPO achieves 2-3x improvement in sample efficiency over prior methods in fine-tuning and leveraging offline data settings.

papers.title: Efficient Offline Reinforcement Learning via Peer-Influenced Constraint
papers.contribution: PIC and EPIC achieve competitive performance on D4RL continuous control tasks while maintaining efficiency and discovering the coupling effect between peer influence and uncertainty estimation.

papers.title: Fine-tuning Behavioral Cloning Policies with Preference‑Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Derives regret bounds shrinking with offline demonstration quantity; validates lower regret than standalone behavioral cloning or online preference-based RL.

papers.title: Hybrid Reinforcement: when reward is sparse, better to be dense
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms reward model-only and verifier-only baselines across mathematical reasoning benchmarks with strong gains on both verifiable and hard-to-verify tasks.

papers.title: Imitation Learning as Return Distribution Matching
papers.contribution: RS-KT achieves substantially lower sample complexity than RS-BC by exploiting dynamics information, with provably efficient algorithms for both known and unknown reward settings.

papers.title: Koopman-Assisted Trajectory Synthesis: A Data Augmentation Framework for Offline Imitation Learning
papers.contribution: Substantially enhances policy performance and achieves state-of-the-art results, especially in demanding scenarios with narrow expert data distributions.

papers.title: Latent Wasserstein Adversarial Imitation Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves expert-level performance using only one or a few state-only expert episodes, outperforming prior Wasserstein-based and adversarial IL methods on MuJoCo environments.

papers.title: MIRACLE: Model-free Imitation and Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Cut-Selection
papers.contribution: MIRACLE achieves 98.1% memory reduction with 0.08% objective gap, 3.78x average speedup on MIPLIB problems, and 100% success rate on instances where SCIP fails 47-53% of the time.

papers.title: Near-Optimal Second-Order Guarantees for Model-Based Adversarial Imitation Learning
papers.contribution: Attains minimax-optimal sample complexity for online interaction and matches lower bounds on expert demonstrations in horizon and precision dependence.

papers.title: Provably Efficient Policy-Reward Co-Pretraining for Adversarial Imitation Learning
papers.contribution: CoPT-AIL achieves an improved imitation gap bound over standard AIL and provides the first theoretical guarantee for pretraining benefits in adversarial imitation learning.

papers.title: Towards High Data Efficiency in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward
papers.contribution: Achieve 1.85x speedup on AIME24 and 1.66x speedup on AIME25 using only 20% of training data compared to GRPO on full dataset.

papers.title: A Regret Minimization Framework on Preference Learning in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Demonstrates consistent performance gains on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and human-annotated preference datasets compared to standard reward-maximization approaches.

papers.title: All Roads Lead to Likelihood: The Value of Reinforcement Learning in Fine-Tuning
papers.contribution: Explains why two-stage online fine-tuning only searches over a reduced policy subset, requiring less data than offline fine-tuning.

papers.title: Alternating Reinforcement Learning for Rubric-Based Reward Modeling in Non-Verifiable LLM Post-Training
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly improves downstream policy alignment in both offline and online RL settings.

papers.title: B-Spar: Bayesian Sparse-Reward Modeling for RL-based Image Editing
papers.contribution: Improves perceptual quality by 95% over AIGC baselines and ~33.5% over state-of-the-art with stable training.

papers.title: Beyond the Proxy: Trajectory-Distilled Guidance for Offline GFlowNet Training
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms existing baselines in convergence speed and sample quality for offline GFlowNet training.

papers.title: COLLIE: Guiding Skill Discovery in Semantically Coherent Latent Space
papers.contribution: COLLIE learns diverse, human-aligned skills while avoiding hazardous behaviors and achieving superior downstream performance with minimal human feedback.

papers.title: Causal Imitation Learning under Expert-Observable and Expert-Unobservable Confounding
papers.contribution: DML-IL provides theoretical imitation gap bounds and outperforms existing causal IL baselines on continuous state-action environments including Mujoco tasks.

papers.title: CoRe: Combined Rewards with Vision-Language Model Feedback for Preference-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing approaches on ten robotic manipulation tasks in simulation and five real-world tasks through preference-aligned reward construction.

papers.title: Consistent Zero-Shot Imitation with Contrastive Goal Inference
papers.contribution: Consistently recovers demonstrator's intent by accounting for relative difficulty of reaching states, outperforming prior zero-shot imitation methods.

papers.title: DenseGRPO: From Sparse to Dense Reward for Flow Matching Model Alignment
papers.contribution: Dense rewards enable effective training by aligning feedback signals with intermediate denoising step contributions across multiple standard benchmarks.

papers.title: Distributional Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Empirical results on synthetic benchmarks, real-world neurobehavioral data, and MuJoCo control tasks demonstrate that our method recovers expressive reward representations and achieves state-of-the-ar

papers.title: Diversity-Incentivized Exploration for Versatile Reasoning
papers.contribution: DIVER outperforms competitive RLVR baselines on in-domain and out-of-domain tasks, excelling in both Pass@1 and Pass@k evaluations across reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: DualCOIL: Offline Imitation Learning from Contrasting Demonstrations
papers.contribution: Consistent improvements over baselines on standard benchmarks without adversarial training, handling positive and negative demonstrations in unified framework.

papers.title: From Reward-Free Representations to Preferences: Rethinking Offline Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves superior preference efficiency over offline PbRL baselines, first connecting RFRL with PbRL for feedback-efficient solution.

papers.title: GRACE: A Language Model Framework for Explainable Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Efficiently learns highly accurate rewards on MuJoCo, BabyAI, and AndroidWorld benchmarks with strong policy performance compared to competitive imitation learning and RL approaches.

papers.title: Guided Flow Policy: Learning from High-Value Actions in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on 144 tasks from OGBench, Minari, D4RL with substantial gains on suboptimal datasets and challenging tasks.

papers.title: Guided Policy Optimization under Partial Observability
papers.contribution: GPO significantly outperforms existing methods on continuous control with partial observability and memory-based challenges.

papers.title: Hierarchical Value-Decomposed Offline Reinforcement Learning for Whole-Body Control
papers.contribution: HVD significantly outperforms baselines on complex whole-body tasks and enables policy learning from realistic imperfect data rather than perfect demonstrations.

papers.title: Human-in-the-Loop Policy Optimization for Preference-Based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Identifies policies aligned with human preferences on complex quadrupedal robot tasks with limited interactions, outperforming eight state-of-the-art MORL algorithms on MuJoCo and microgrid design tasks.

papers.title: HyMTRL: A Hybrid Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning Framework via Phased Policy Evolution
papers.contribution: Achieves significant improvements in learning efficiency and final performance on MetaWorld benchmark through phased policy evolution.

papers.title: Learn the Ropes, Then Trust the Wins: Self-imitation with Progressive Exploration for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Increases success rates by up to 16.1% (ALFWorld), 20.7% (WebShop), 3.8% (AIME24), and 6.1% (AIME25) over strong baselines with only 10-25% theoretical complexity increase.

papers.title: MAVRL: Learning Reward Functions from Multiple Feedback Types with Amortized Variational Inference
papers.contribution: Jointly inferred reward posteriors outperform single-type baselines, exploit complementary information across feedback types, and yield more robust policies.

papers.title: Matching multiple experts: on the exploitability of multi-agent imitation learning
papers.contribution: Provides Nash imitation gap of O(nε_BC/(1-γ)^2) for dominant strategy expert equilibria under BC error ε_BC.

papers.title: Multi-Objective Preference Optimization: Improving Human Alignment of Generative Models
papers.contribution: Recovers Pareto-optimal policies achieving higher rewards and Pareto-dominating baselines on human-preference data.

papers.title: Multi-agent imitation learning with function approximation: linear Markov games and beyond
papers.contribution: Achieves sample complexity depending only on feature dimension d and outperforms behavioral cloning on Tic-Tac-Toe and Connect4.

papers.title: Multi-timescale Reinforcement Learning by Value Reconstruction
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms SOTA on DMControl and CARLA; works with both off-policy (SAC, DrQ-v2) and on-policy (PPO) algorithms.

papers.title: Noise-Guided Transport: Imitation Learning from Random Priors
papers.contribution: Achieves strong performance on high-dimensional continuous control with as few as 20 transitions in ultra-low data regimes.

papers.title: Non-Adversarial Imitation Learning Provably Free of Compounding Errors: The Value Flow Mechanism
papers.contribution: First non-adversarial imitation learning method theoretically guaranteed to eliminate compounding errors, equivalent to adversarial imitation learning in mitigating horizon-dependent gaps.

papers.title: Offline Preference-Based Value Optimization
papers.contribution: PVO attains rate-optimal sample complexity of O(ε^-2) and consistently outperforms strong baselines on continuous control benchmarks with robust and stable performance.

papers.title: On Discovering Algorithms for Adversarial Imitation Learning
papers.contribution: Discovered reward assignment functions generalize across unseen environments and optimization algorithms, outperforming human-designed baselines with more stable training.

papers.title: Online Compatible Reward Identification from Preference Feedback
papers.contribution: Establishes theoretical foundations for online compatible reward identification with characterization of problem complexity and sample efficiency.

papers.title: PAWS: Preference Learning with Advantage-Weighted Segments
papers.contribution: Preserves trajectory-level preference information and avoids unreliable per-step signals, consistently outperforming existing preference-based RL methods on manipulation and locomotion.

papers.title: Policy Likelihood-based Query Sampling and Critic-Exploited Reset for Efficient Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: PoLiCER consistently outperforms existing preference-based RL methods across diverse locomotion and robotic manipulation tasks.

papers.title: Posterior Behavioral Cloning: Pretraining BC Policies for Efficient RL Finetuning
papers.contribution: Significantly improves RL finetuning performance on realistic robotic control benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks.

papers.title: Preference-based Policy Optimization from Sparse-reward Offline Dataset
papers.contribution: Substantially outperformed state-of-the-art baselines in learning efficiency and final performance on challenging sparse-reward offline RL benchmarks.

papers.title: RAMAC: Multimodal Risk-Aware Offline Reinforcement Learning and the Role of Behavior Regularization
papers.contribution: Achieves consistent gains in CVaR_{0.1} while maintaining strong returns on Stochastic-D4RL and illustrative 2D bandit.

papers.title: Recovering Hidden Reward in Diffusion-Based Policies
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art imitation performance on manipulation tasks while providing effective reward signals for downstream RL without adversarial training.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Pairwise Preferences in Long-Term Decision Problems
papers.contribution: Shows superior learning efficiency compared to prior work in high-dimensional decision problems with long time horizons.

papers.title: Replay Failures as Successes: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following
papers.contribution: Achieves promising results on complex instruction following with less computational budget by enabling learning from partial successes.

papers.title: Revisiting Distribution Correction Estimation for Offline Imitation Learning with Suboptimal Dataset
papers.contribution: ReDICE consistently outperforms prior methods on standard and real-world offline IL benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art results.

papers.title: Reward Learning through Ranking Mean Squared Error
papers.contribution: R4's solution set is provably minimal and complete, and it consistently matches or outperforms existing rating and preference-based RL methods on robotic benchmarks.

papers.title: Rubric Curriculum RL: Exploiting the Generation-Verification Gap in Non-Verifiable Domains
papers.contribution: RcRL preserves output entropy past 1000 steps (vs baselines plateauing within hundreds), achieves 70.5% preference on creative writing, and 25.4% improvement on HealthBench consensus.

papers.title: Self-Predictive Representations for Combinatorial Generalization in Behavioral Cloning
papers.contribution: BYOL-γ achieves competitive performance on challenging tasks requiring combinatorial generalization through improved temporal consistency in representations.

papers.title: TimeRewarder: Learning Dense Reward from Passive Videos via Frame-wise Temporal Distance
papers.contribution: On Meta-World tasks, achieves nearly perfect success in 9/10 tasks with 200,000 environment interactions per task, outperforming prior methods and manual environment rewards in both success rate and sample efficiency.

papers.title: Trust Region Inverse Reinforcement Learning: Explicit Dual Ascent using Local Policy Updates
papers.contribution: Outperforms imitation learning baselines by 2.4x on challenging tasks while recovering reward functions generalizing to dynamics shifts.

papers.title: UniRRM: Unified Reasoning Reward Models Across Languages and Evaluation Paradigms
papers.contribution: Achieves near state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks on comparable model sizes and remains effective for unseen evaluation paradigms.

papers.title: WebArbiter: A Generative Reasoning Process Reward Model for Web Agents
papers.contribution: WebArbiter-7B outperforms Gemini Flash by 10.9% on WebPRMBench through reasoning-first process reward modeling.

papers.title: What Reward Structure Enables Efficient Sparse-Reward RL? A Proof-of-Concept with Policy-Aware Matrix Completion
papers.contribution: PAMC achieves 4100±250 return on Montezuma's Revenge (vs 200±50 for DrQ-v2), 78% success on MetaWorld-50 (vs 65%), and 15% improvement over CQL on D4RL datasets.

papers.title: When Does Predictive Inverse Dynamics Outperform Behavior Cloning?
papers.contribution: PIDM achieves lower prediction error and requires up to five times fewer demonstrations than BC on 2D navigation; on complex 3D environments, BC requires over 66% more samples than PIDM.

papers.title: Zero-Shot Adaptation of Behavioral Foundation Models to Unseen Dynamics
papers.contribution: The method achieves up to 2x higher zero-shot returns in changing dynamics settings for both discrete and continuous tasks.
